10724-the-store-boy.title: The Store Boy
10724-the-store-boy.creator: Unknown
10724-the-store-boy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "I haven't been so prosperous, if that's what you mean. I'm a straightforward man, I am. You always know where to find me. There ain't no piety about me. What are you laughin' at?"

arxiv-2104-12782.title: Emerging dissipative phases in a superradiant quantum gas with tunable decay
arxiv-2104-12782.creator: Francesco Ferri, Rodrigo Rosa-Medina, Fabian Finger, Nishant Dogra, Matteo Soriente, Oded Zilberberg, Tobias Donner, Tilman Esslinger
arxiv-2104-12782.description: Abstract Exposing a many-body system to external drives and losses can transform the nature of its phases and opens perspectives for engineering new properties of matter. How such characteristics are related to the underlying microscopic processes of the driven and dissipative system is a fundamental question.

arxiv-2204-00373.title: The Hutchinson-Barnsley theory for generalized iterated function systems by means of infinite iterated function systems
arxiv-2204-00373.creator: Elismar R. Oliveira
arxiv-2204-00373.description: Abstract The study of generalized iterated function systems (GIFS) was introduced by Mihail and Miculescu in 2008. We provide a new approach to study those systems as the limit of the Hutchinson-Barnsley setting for infinite iterated function systems (IIFS) which has been developed by many authors in the last years.

arxiv-2207-04648.title: Learning Large-scale Universal User Representation with Sparse Mixture of Experts
arxiv-2207-04648.creator: Caigao Jiang, Siqiao Xue, James Zhang, Lingyue Liu, Zhibo Zhu, Hongyan Hao
arxiv-2207-04648.description: Abstract Learning user sequence behaviour embedding is very sophisticated and challenging due to the complicated feature interactions over time and high dimensions of user features. Recent emerging foundation models, e . g ., BERT and its variants, encourage a large body of researchers to investigate in this field.

arxiv-2212-02572.title: On the LISA science performance in observations of short-lived signals from massive black hole binary coalescences
arxiv-2212-02572.creator: Geraint Pratten, Antoine Klein, Christopher J. Moore, Hannah Middleton, Nathan Steinle, Patricia Schmidt and Alberto Vecchio
arxiv-2212-02572.description: Abstract The observation of massive black hole binary systems is one of the main science objectives of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). The instrument’s design requirements have recently been revised: they set a requirement at 0.1 ​ mHz 0.1\,\mathrm{mHz} , with no additional explicit requirements at lower frequencies.

arxiv-2305-12019.title: A Foray into Parallel Optimisation Algorithms for High Dimension Low Sample Space (HDLSS) Generalized Distance Weighted Discrimination problems
arxiv-2305-12019.creator: Srivathsan Amruth, Advisor: Xin Yee Lam
arxiv-2305-12019.description: Abstract In many modern data sets, High dimension low sample size (HDLSS) data is prevalent in many fields of studies. There has been an increased focus recently on using machine learning and statistical methods to mine valuable information out of these data sets. Thus, there has been an increased interest in efficient learning in high dimensions.

arxiv-2402-19292.title: Fundamental Limits of Throughput and Availability: Applications to prophet inequalities & transaction fee mechanism design
arxiv-2402-19292.creator: Aadityan Ganesh, Jason Hartline, Atanu R Sinha, Matthew vonAllmen
arxiv-2402-19292.description: Abstract This paper studies the fundamental limits of availability and throughput for independent and heterogeneous demands of a limited resource. Availability is the probability that the demands are below the capacity of the resource. Throughput is the expected fraction of the resource that is utilized by the demands.

arxiv-2411-18790.title: Fast Schulze Voting Using Quickselect
arxiv-2411-18790.creator: Arushi Arora, David Eppstein, Randy Le Huynh
arxiv-2411-18790.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Arushi Arora, David Eppstein, Randy Le Huynh. The Schulze voting method aggregates voter preference data using maxmin-weight graph paths, achieving the Condorcet property that a candidate who would win every head-to-head contest will also win the overall election.

arxiv-2502-05209.title: Model Tampering Attacks Enable More Rigorous Evaluations of LLM Capabilities
arxiv-2502-05209.creator: Zora Che, University of Maryland, ML Alignment & Theory Scholars zche@umd.edu, Stephen Casper, MIT CSAIL, ML Alignment & Theory Scholars scasper@mit.edu, Robert Kirk, UK AI Security Institute, Anirudh Satheesh, University of Maryland, Stewart Slocum, MIT, Lev McKinney, University of Toronto, Rohit G
arxiv-2502-05209.description: Abstract Evaluations of large language model (LLM) risks and capabilities are increasingly being incorporated into AI risk management and governance frameworks. Currently, most risk evaluations are conducted by designing inputs that elicit harmful behaviors from the system. However, this approach suffers from two limitations. First, input-output evaluations cannot evaluate realistic risks from open-weight models.

pmc-10670011.title: Evaluation of Physical Literacy in 9- to 11-Year-Old Children: Reliability and Validity of Two Measurement Tools in Three Southeastern European Countries
pmc-10670011.creator: Petra Rajkovic Vuletic, Marijana Geets Kesic, Barbara Gilic, Miran Pehar, Edin Uzicanin, Kemal Idrizovic, Damir Sekulic
pmc-10670011.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The awareness of the importance of physical literacy (PL) is globally increasing; however, knowledge of the applicability of PL measurement tools in southeastern Europe is limited. The aim of this study was to evaluate the reliability and validity of translated versions of the CAPL-2 and PLAYself questionnaires in 9- to 11-year-old elementary school children from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro.

pmc-11322058.title: Programmed cell death in Helicobacter pylori infection and related gastric cancer
pmc-11322058.creator: Yukun Lin, Kunjing Liu, Fang Lu, Changming Zhai, Fafeng Cheng
pmc-11322058.description: Programmed cell death (PCD) plays a crucial role in maintaining the normal structure and function of the digestive tract in the body. Infection with Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is an important factor leading to gastric damage, promoting the Correa cascade and accelerating the transition from gastritis to gastric cancer.

pmc-11390033.title: Creatine Kinase Surge: Levetiracetam-Induced Rhabdomyolysis
pmc-11390033.creator: Kaitlyn N Romero, Melville C O'Brien, Avni Agrawal, Irtiza Hasan
pmc-11390033.description: Rhabdomyolysis is the breakdown of muscle cells secondary to both traumatic and non-traumatic causes. The lysing of the muscle cells can lead to the release of cell contents that can lead to acute injury and other life-threatening conditions. Levetiracetam is an anticonvulsant commonly used in generalized and partial tonic-clonic seizures.

pmc-11547440.title: Validation of a Food Frequency Questionnaire: VioScreen-Allergy
pmc-11547440.creator: Kaci Pickett-Nairne, Deborah Glueck, Jessica Thomson, Rick Weiss, Kelly N Z Fuller, Stefka Fabbri, Claudia Schaefer, Courtney Evans, Emily Bowhay, Monica Martinez, Wendy Moore, David Fleischer, Carina Venter, Carlos Pastor-Vargas
pmc-11547440.description: Background/Objectives: An adapted version of an online pictorial food frequency questionnaire (FFQ), VioScreen-Allergy, assesses total dietary intake and intake of allergens and foods in the maternal diet index (MDI), linked to offspring allergy. This study assessed intermethod reliability, test–retest reliability, and external validity of the VioScreen-Allergy.

pmc-11577069.title: Thirteen year experience of vitrectomy and air tamponade for primary retinal detachment repair with clinical outcomes
pmc-11577069.creator: Maurizio Mete, Emilia Maggio, Guido Prigione, Enrico Bruni, Giorgia Maraone, Sarah Tripodi, Nicoletta De Santis, Massimo Guerriero, Grazia Pertile
pmc-11577069.description: PurposeTo report outcomes of pars plana vitrectomy (PPV) with air tamponade for primary rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD) and investigate the impact of vitreous cortex remnants (VCR) on surgical outcomes.MethodsA retrospective review of 900 patients treated for uncomplicated primary RRD between 2007 and 2020.

pmc-11606389.title: Personal and Social Transformative Learning through Community‑Based Education: Insights from Training Socially Accountable Medical Doctors at a Historically Disadvantaged University in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
pmc-11606389.creator: Siyonela Mlonyeni, Sibusiso Cyprian Nomatshila, O.R Mnyaka, Laston Gonah, Olanrewaju Oladimeji
pmc-11606389.description: Background: In 2014, the Faculty of Health Sciences at Walter Sisulu University introduced a 20‑week long integrated longitudinal clinical clerkship (ILCC) rotation block as part of its commitment to community‑based education and social responsiveness, with the goal of ensuring that the curriculum is updated to align with the contemporary health system challenges in South Africa.

pmc-12820379.title: Structure of the 30S translation initiation complex coupled to paused RNA polymerase and its potential for riboregulation
pmc-12820379.creator: Johann J. Roske, Giulia Paris, Akanksha Goyal, Marina Rodnina, Nikolay Zenkin, Katarzyna J. Bandyra, Ben F. Luisi
pmc-12820379.description: In many bacterial species, transcription and translation can be coupled physically, with potential impact on the rates and efficiency of gene expression. Here, we present structural evidence from cryo-EM demonstrating that a bacterial RNA polymerase that is paused proximally to the promoter can associate with the pioneering 30S translation initiation complex (30S IC).

pmc-13086033.title: Giant Uterine Leiomyosarcoma with Ascitic Cytology Positive: A Case Report on Diagnostic and Surgical Challenges in a Low-Resource Setting
pmc-13086033.creator: Nasteho Mohamud Mudei, Ismail A Ali, Abdullahi Abdirahman Omar, Abdiwali Mohamed Hussein, Mariam Mohamed Mohamud Adawe, Fahmo Hussein Ibrahim
pmc-13086033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionUterine leiomyosarcoma (uLMS) is a rare, aggressive smooth-muscle malignancy that constitutes only a small fraction of uterine cancers but contributes significantly to morbidity and mortality. Preoperative distinction from benign fibroids remains challenging, particularly in low-resource settings. This report aims to describe a case of giant uterine leiomyosarcoma with peritoneal dissemination and highlight the diagnostic and surgical challenges encountered in a resource-limited environment.Case PresentationA 45-year-old multiparous woman from rural Somalia presented with a five-year history of progressive abdominal distension and irregular vaginal bleeding.

pmc-13121257.title: Developing sensitive quality indicators for ground inter-hospital transport of adult critically ill patients using Donabedian model
pmc-13121257.creator: Qianqian Zhang, Ge Zang, Naifu Tang, Li Zhang, Manman Yin, Tongtong Zhang, Bo Li
pmc-13121257.description: BackgroundThe complexity of inter-hospital transport (IHT) for critically ill patients poses challenges to quality evaluation. Currently, sensitive quality indicators for the entire process of IHT remain lacking. The objective of this study is to develop a set of standardized and quantifiable quality evaluation indicators for land-based IHT of adult critically ill patients.
